title: Gas stoves aren't really that fast - even standard electric is faster!
summary: Technology Connections tests how quickly gas, induction and standard electric stoves boil water, with CO2 measurements and a discussion of the advantages and disadvantages of each.
why: Cited as the data-backed source for the claim that electric and induction stoves boil water as fast as or faster than gas.

quote.text: Technology Connections on YouTube actually tested this and found electric to be slightly faster
